modifications: Placeholders and the instructional comments are replaced by Go text/template actions (delimiters <% and %>); every action is an encoder call (tex, rich for text that may hold one bold span, url, paper).
Paper size is an enumerated class option; the date is data instead of \today.
Body paragraphs are a range over blocks, each optionally followed by a list set outside \lettercontent in the body font, as the example prescribes.
The font path of the list wrapper follows the class (fonts/raleway/).
A blank line follows the date, and the list's top space is taken back before it begins and 3 pt follow it, so the spacing between date, salutation, paragraphs and list is even.
A contact separator is tied to the item before it, so a wrapped contact line never starts with one.

The file carries no other copyright or licence statement and its history was not audited for third-party text. The template loads moderncv, an installed TeX package whose licence is inventoried separately.

modifications: Placeholders and the setup comments are replaced by Go text/template actions (delimiters <% and %>); every action is an encoder call (tex, rich for text that may hold one bold span, url, paper).
Paper size is an enumerated option; the PDF title is a fixed string.
Sections are data-driven and omitted when empty; the publications, honors and references sections of the example are removed.
Section headings come from a per-language label set, a Selected Projects section is added and each experience or project entry is set in a minipage so an entry is never split across pages.

The list that wrapped each section is removed: entries are set directly under their heading and competencies, the summary and languages as \cvitem lines, so no stray outer marker appears beside an entry. A Summary section heads the profile paragraph.
The entry gaps and list spacing have one reviewed tight variant (1pt gaps, no extra bullet spacing) that a layout repair round may select; font size and geometry scale are untouched by it.
The contact-line symbols (mobile, fixed phone, email, homepage) are set to nothing, because their icon glyphs extract as words in the PDF text an applicant tracking system reads.
The space between the first and last name is set in the name font and the body font's tie is taken back, because the narrower tie extracted as no space ("JordanAvery") in that text.
The preamble (moderncv banking and blue colour fix, hyperref hook, geometry) is otherwise unchanged.

modifications: Result is one schema-versioned JSON document on stdout (schema_version 1) instead of console text.
Each layout property is its own pass, fail or unverified check; a missing or broken extractor makes every check unverified.
Poppler pdftotext is addressed by a required absolute --pdftotext path; the PATH lookup is removed.
The PDF is read once; Poppler reads a private copy of the hashed bytes, made beside the PDF in the caller's build directory, and the verdict carries the SHA-256.
The thresholds become one profile per template and paper size, chosen by required --template and --paper arguments and echoed in the result; their values are unchanged.
Word boxes are kept (not only lines) and unescaped, and the page width is read, for four added checks: page-size, clipping, text-overlap and, for the résumé profile only, entry-gap.
The line classes, find_orphans and the hole, early-end, footer, thin-page and orphan rules are unchanged; a document without a single page of text is unverified.

modifications: Result is one schema-versioned JSON document on stdout (schema_version 1) instead of console text; the process exits 0 once a complete result was written.
Every check is pass, fail or unverified; a check that could not run is never a pass.
pypdf is the only extractor: the Poppler fallback, the subprocess helpers and the page-count parser are removed.
The PDF is read once and the verdict carries the SHA-256 of exactly those bytes.
Required text is reported by index, not quoted; --max-pages is added; --pages, --min-chars, --contains, --dump-text and --ascii-dates are kept.
font_usage is added to the result: the letters set in each font and size, from pypdf's text runs, for a caller that holds a template to its fonts.
normalize_text, find_non_ascii_date_ranges and the date-dash constants are unchanged.
